post.description:
Logs in with the login email and password. Sets the session and CSRF cookies. Answers
401 for any failure and 429 (with `Retry-After`) while throttled.
Ends this session.
Ends every session of the caller, this one included. Refused while impersonating.

get.description: The caller, its memberships and capabilities, and the customers it can open.

patch.description:
The caller's name and notification email (allowed while impersonating, audited with
both IDs).

get.description: The caller's active sessions, newest first.

post.description:
What a link from a mail is for (invitation, reset, email change) and for whom; 422
with `token_invalid` when it is not valid or has expired.
Sets the password of an invited account from the invitation link.
Mails a reset link if the address has an account. The answer is always the same.
Sets a new password from a reset link and ends every session of the account.
Makes the new address the login email, from the link mailed to it.

Changes the password and ends the caller's other sessions. Refused while
impersonating.
Mails a confirmation link to the new address. Refused while impersonating.

Starts acting as the user in this session, for at most 60 minutes. Needs a reason;
another admin cannot be the target.
Ends the impersonation; the session is the admin's again.

Invites a login (Používateľ or Iba na čítanie) by mail; an existing account gets the
access and a notice.
Removes the login's access to this customer; the account stays.
Mails a password reset link, or a new invitation to a login still invited.

get.description: Every user (not purged ones), by name; `q` matches the name or the email.

post.description: Locks the account and ends its sessions.
Soft delete: the account cannot log in and can be restored.
Anonymises a deleted account for good.

get.description: The customer's profile.

delete.description: Soft delete (admins): hidden from everyone else, restorable.

patch.description: The customer's address and bank account (users, staff and admins).

get.description: The provider and its active customers.

patch.description:
Name, IČO and DIČ (staff and admins, plan §2 decision 50). The IČO stays unique among
active customers (409).

put.description: The customer's variable number (staff and admins); null clears it.

post.description: Deletes a soft-deleted customer for good; its IČO must be typed to confirm.
A new customer in the staff member's own provider.

get.description: The provider's customers with their logins nested (Používatelia).

post.description:
A new customer in the staff member's provider as a copy of one of its customers. The
copy runs as a job; follow it at `/api/customers/{id}/jobs/{job_id}`.
A new customer, in a provider or unassigned (admins).

get.description: Every customer with its logins nested (admins).

post.description: A new customer as a copy of any customer, in a provider or unassigned (admins).

get.description: Every provider with its staff and customers (Servisné účty).

delete.description:
Removes the provider: its customers become unassigned and its staff memberships are
deactivated.

put.description: Assigns the customer to a provider; one already assigned elsewhere is a 409.

get.description: The customer's parameters for the year (plan §6.4); 404 while it has none.

put.description: Sets the customer's parameters for the year; 422 names each invalid field.

get.description:
The knowledge health report (plan §6.5): missing lists, conventions naming missing
accounts, budget EKs without a bridge rule, precedents outside the active lists.
The customer's lists for the year, each with its active version.

A page of the list's entries in their order. `q` searches the key and the text fields
regardless of case and diacritics.

post.description: Adds a row: a new version of the list. 409 when another edit came first.

get.description: The list's versions for the year, the newest first.
Entries added, removed and changed from one version to another.

put.description: Changes a row's fields (those given): a new version of the list.

post.description: Deactivates a row: it stays in the new version, the engine no longer sees it.

get.description: The customer's coding conventions for the year (revision 0 and empty while none).

put.description:
Replaces the conventions for the year; 409 when someone saved since `revision`, 422
with the field when the document does not validate.

get.description: Which global lists exist for which year: every year with one, this year and the next.

post.description:
The engine's proposal for the invoice, coded with the customer's code lists,
parameters and conventions for the invoice's booking year. Nothing is stored. (Supplier
memory and counters come from the demo's files until P2-M4.) 409 when the customer has no
lists or parameters for that year.

get.description:
Newest first. `actor_id` matches the actor or the real actor; `action` is a whole
action or a prefix ending in a dot.
The state of one of the customer's jobs (a copy, an import's dry run or apply).
The outbox, newest first; `to` filters by part of the address.

post.description: The whole line a position the accountant picked brings: MD, DAL, transfer, texts.

Stores the accountant's verdict: the coding becomes the supplier's newest precedent,
its number is used up, and the feedback is logged. A corrected coding must pass the
dictionary checks; whether its sum matches the invoice is the accountant's call.

get.description: The feedback stored since the last `riso reset`, oldest first.

The document counters, invoice series first: the last number used, the one the
counter would fill in next, and the numbers taken. Only feedback moves them.

The latest report of `riso eval`; runs the evaluation when there is none yet, or
when asked to refresh it.
